question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is **"Buisness"**.
 
• The correct spelling is** "Business". **
 
• **Business **generally refers to an organization or an entity engaged in commercial, industrial, or professional activities with the primary goal of earning profits by producing and selling goods or services to customers.
 
• The term "**business**" can also refer to the broader field of commerce, including finance, marketing, management, and other related areas.
 
• In short, the term **"business"** is used to describe a wide range of activities and entities involved in commerce and trade.
 
• **Examples: **
 
 
• She runs a successful **business **selling handmade jewelry. 
 
• The new restaurant is expected to bring in a lot of **business**. 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are correctly spelled words: 
 
• **Camouflage**: the use of any combination of materials, coloration, or illumination for concealment.
 
• **Building**: a structure with walls and a roof, typically used for shelter, storage, or as a workplace.
 
• **Camphor**: a white crystalline substance with a strong odor, used as a moth repellent and in medicinal preparations. 
 
• **Examples: **
 
 
• The old **building **was renovated and turned into a trendy coffee shop. 
 
• The hiker wore **camouflage **clothing to blend in with the surroundings. 
 
• The ointment contained **camphor **to relieve muscle pain.
